Local landscaping

Landscaping in Gregory Hills, from handover to finished yard

Gregory Hills is a modern estate suburb, and most blocks handed over as bare compacted fill with design guidelines and a landscaping bond attached. We build the whole yard, front and back, to those guidelines so you clear the bond and get a garden that suits the home.

As the earlier streets mature, we also do plenty of garden refreshes and maintenance. Either way, it is one licensed local team, a fixed price, and no call-out fee.

Get your fixed-price quote

props.label: Section
props.html:
FAQs

Landscaping in Gregory Hills: your questions answered

Can you clear a Gregory Hills landscaping bond?
Yes. We build front and back to your estate's design guidelines and bond conditions so you meet the deadline and get your bond back, with a finished yard to show for it.
Do you do smaller garden jobs in Gregory Hills too?
Yes, from a single garden refresh to ongoing maintenance. No job is too small, and there is no call-out fee to come and quote it.
Do you charge a call-out fee?
No. Coming out to look at your job and quote it is free, every time. You only pay once you accept a fixed-price quote and we get to work.
Are you licensed and insured?
Yes, we are a licensed contractor. We are happy to show our credentials before any work starts, so you know exactly who is on your property.
How soon can you start?
Often quickly, especially for smaller jobs and quotes. We are open 7am to 7pm, 7 days, so call 0451 267 287 and we will tell you honestly what we can do.
